title: Tiny, cute alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left bell -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='34' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='34' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- right bell -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- hammer -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='4' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='27' width='3' height='8' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x='30' y='80' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x='65' y='80' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='27' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#ff9e9e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- inner face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='20' fill='#fff5e6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- hour ticks -->
  <rect x='49' y='40' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='49' y='72' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='32' y='57' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='64' y='57' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='42' y2='48' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='58' y2='45' stroke='#ff8c42' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- center dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- cute eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='62' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='62' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='61' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='61' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 68 Q50 72 55 68' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
